title: Opt-in --stream mode forwarding live child output for fledge run tasks
description: Opt-in --stream mode forwarding live child output for fledge run tasks
acceptance_criteria: fledge run --stream --json forwards child stdout and stderr to fledge's stderr as they arrive while still filling the envelope's stdout and stderr fields exactly as the buffered path did; the envelope field set and schema_version are unchanged; buffered capture remains the default when --stream is absent; exit codes are propagated identically in both modes; streamed and buffered envelopes for the same failing task are equal; --stream without --json is an accepted no-op that preserves the task summary; cargo test, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --check are green.
